title: Person
description: A type designer or other professional involved in creating typefaces, digital or pre-digital.

id.description: Permanent opaque identifier. Never reused, never changed once assigned.

slug.description: URL/filename-friendly slug. May change if a record is renamed; id does not.

previous_slugs.description: Slugs this record used to have before being renamed. The build emits a redirect stub page at each old URL pointing at the current one, so old links keep working. Append the old slug here whenever you change `slug`, never remove an entry once added.

sort_name.description: Name form used for alphabetical listing, useful for non-Latin or family-name-first names.

birth_year.description: Free-form to allow uncertain precision, e.g. '1901' or 'c. 1890'.

roles.description: e.g. type designer, punchcutter, calligrapher, type engineer.

bio.description: Short plain-text summary, a few sentences. Not a full biography.

lc_naf.description: Library of Congress/NACO Authority File id, e.g. 'n79021164'.

worldcat_entity.description: OCLC WorldCat Entity id, the string after id.oclc.org/worldcat/entity/. Note: the WorldCat.org detail page for an entity currently prompts for a library-affiliated login to view, unlike the other authority files here, still worth recording as a cross-reference even though the page itself isn't always freely browsable.

external_ids.description: Informational cross-references only, one per authority file. Never usable as a sources entry.

sources.description: Independent, verifiable sources. Must never be Wikidata, Wikipedia, or any Wikimedia project, enforced by scripts/validate.js.

verification_status.description: Set to needs_verification when sources are thin or low-confidence (e.g. a bare LinkedIn profile) rather than omitting the record entirely. Absent/'verified' means sources are considered solid.
